newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end higher as U.S. data drives Dow rally.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end higher as U.S. data drives Dow rally.

text.p: London's FTSE 100 share index rebounded after two days of decline to end higher on Tuesday, rescued by a rejuvenated Dow that charged ahead after weaker-than-expected U.S. wage inflation figures.
The FTSE closed 25.4 points higher at 4,237.4, carried up by a buoyant Dow which was 93 points higher as London closed.

Dealers said the fourth-quarter U.S. Employment Costs Index (ECI), up 0.8 percent compared with expectations of a 0.9 percent climb, had soothed fears among some investors that a near-term U.S. interest rate increase could send the Dow tumbling.
